name: Game Connect
description: Let game servers connect to this site themselves: queued delivery that survives a restart, live status, the store and credits in game, and account linking, for any game with a client
author: Blysis

settings.label: Long-poll hold (seconds)
settings.description: How long the site keeps a server's request open waiting for work. Keep it under your proxy's idle timeout.

settings.label: Status interval (seconds)
settings.description: How often a server reports who is online. A player counts as online for two intervals after the last report.

settings.label: Delivery lease (seconds)
settings.description: How long a server may hold a delivery without answering before it is set aside for review.

api.description: A game server process introduces itself with its token and becomes the token's current process.
The long-poll a game server holds open; whatever it returns is already claimed by that server.
A game server reports what happened to the deliveries it claimed.
A game server reports who is online on it.
What a game may show and sell: the shelves and products an admin marked for games.
Whether a player has an account here, with its balance and gift switch.
A player asks for a code to confirm on the site.
A player types a code a member made on the site.
A player sends credits to another player or member.
Staff in game add, remove, set or read a balance, on a server allowed to.
The members who hold the most credits, or bought the most.
The community goal and how far this month has come.
A player buys with credits, for themselves or as a gift.
What a player has not claimed, gifts waiting included.
Send a ready chest item to delivery.
The recipient accepts a gift waiting in their chest.
The gifts a player sent, waiting or accepted.
The sender takes back a gift nobody accepted, and the money with it.
Whether a player takes gifts.
A player turns credits into a voucher.
Staff mint a voucher nobody paid for, on a server allowed to.
A player cashes a voucher in, once.
Which game account a code made in game would link, and the signed-in member's agreement to link that account.
A signed-in member asks for a code to type in game.
The game accounts the signed-in member linked, and letting one go.
List every game server with its connection, or give one a new token (shown once).
Switch a connection on or off, change what it may do, or revoke its token.
The delivery queue, filtered by state, server or purchase.
Mark a job done, send it again or cancel it, alone or with the rest of its purchase.
Every voucher made in game, open or redeemed, with who made and who redeemed it.
Every game account linked to a member, searchable by either name.
Unlink a game account from its member.

gameConnect.srv_subtitle: Give a game server a token, and choose what it may do. A token is shown once.
gameConnect.srv_none: No game servers yet. Add one under Game Servers first.
gameConnect.srv_newTokenConfirm: The token {server} uses now stops working at once. Put the new one in its config before it can connect again.
gameConnect.srv_revokeConfirm: {server} can no longer connect. Its queued deliveries stay where they are.
gameConnect.srv_tokenOnce: Copy it now: this page will not show it again. Write it as site.token in the plugin's config.
gameConnect.srv_power_enabled_hint: Off stops this server receiving deliveries without revoking its token.
gameConnect.srv_power_allowCreditAdmin_hint: Lets staff on this server add, remove and set a member's credits.
gameConnect.srv_power_allowVoucherGive_hint: Lets staff on this server give vouchers nobody paid for.
gameConnect.srv_power_acceptFollowPlayer: Takes deliveries that follow the buyer
gameConnect.srv_power_acceptFollowPlayer_hint: Runs a delivery meant for whichever server the buyer is on, when they are here.
gameConnect.q_subtitle: Every command a purchase sent to a game server, and where it stands.
gameConnect.q_wrongState: That job is no longer in a state this applies to
gameConnect.v_subtitle: Credits turned into an item in game, and who redeemed them.
gameConnect.l_unlinkConfirm: {player} is no longer linked to {member}. Neither account loses anything.
gameConnect.link_intro: Link the account you play with to this site, to buy in game and keep your credits in one place.
gameConnect.link_codeFromGame: The code the game gave you
gameConnect.link_preview: This code links the {platform} account {name} to you.
gameConnect.link_previewWarn: If that is not your account, stop here: somebody may have sent you their code.
gameConnect.link_otherWay: Or make a code here and type it in game:
gameConnect.link_wrongCode: That code is wrong, used or expired. Make a new one in game.
gameConnect.link_already: That account or yours is already linked. Unlink it first.
gameConnect.link_tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes.
gameConnect.link_failed: Could not make a code. Try again.
